mavzu: Unit 4: My future plans. Lesson 1.B. Looking back... moving on...

savollar.savol: Mother Teresa qaysi yilda tug'ilgan?
Mother Teresaning haqiqiy ismi nima edi?
Agnes qaysi davlatda tug'ilgan?
Agnes oilada qanday farzand edi?
Agnes necha yoshida otasidan judo bo'ldi?
Agnes qaysi yilda oilasini tark etib rohiba bo'ldi?
Missionaries of Charity tashkiloti qaysi yilda tashkil etilgan?
Mother Teresa Nobel Tinchlik mukofotini qaysi yilda olgan?
Matnga ko'ra, 'independent' (mustaqil) shaxs qanday ta'riflanadi?
Exercise 4 dagi fazilatlar ro'yxatida qaysi so'z salbiy (negative) ma'noga ega?
'One option is to persuade students to go to speaking clubs to improve their speaking skills' gapini maslahat modal fe'li bilan qayta yozsak, qaysi variant to'g'ri?
variantlar: Students should go to speaking clubs.
Students must go to speaking clubs.
Students can't go to speaking clubs.

savollar.savol: 'If you don't learn this grammar, you will have problem with your essay' gapini 'had better' yordamida qayta yozing:
variantlar: You had better learn this grammar.
You had better forget this grammar.
You had better avoid this grammar.
You had better not learn this grammar.

savollar.savol: Matnga ko'ra, Agnesning onasi unga nimalarni o'rgatgan?
variantlar: Duo qilish, sevish va yordam berishni

savollar.savol: Otasi vafot etgach, Agnes oilasi qanday ahvolga tushdi?
Agnesning onasi qiyinchilikni qanday yengib o'tdi?
'A person who shares everything with other people' ta'rifi qaysi xususiyatga mos keladi?
'A person who doesn't rely on other people' ta'rifi qaysi so'zga mos keladi?
Mother Teresa Hindistonda nima qildi?
Matnga ko'ra, Agnesning ikkinchi hayotiy saboqi nima edi?
variantlar: Qiyinchilikda harakat qilish va taslim bo'lmaslik kerak

savollar.savol: Exercise 2 dagi ro'yxatga ko'ra, quyidagilardan qaysi biri chet elda o'qishning sabablaridan BIRI EMAS?
Mother Teresaning hayotidagi ikkita saboqni solishtirsak, qaysi umumiy xulosa to'g'ri?
variantlar: Mehr-oqibat va qat'iyat muvaffaqiyat uchun zarur

savollar.savol: Matndagi 'successful person' ta'riflariga asoslanib, Mother Teresa nega muvaffaqiyatli hisoblanadi?
variantlar: U qattiq ishlab, boshqalarga yordam berib, o'z sa'y-harakati bilan yutuqqa erishgani uchun
U hech kimga yordam bermagani uchun

savollar.savol: 'You are coughing. It is because you smoke' gapini maslahat modal fe'li yordamida to'g'ri qayta yozilgan variantni toping:
variantlar: You had better give up smoking.
You could smoke less often only on weekends.

savollar.savol: Agar bir kishi chet elda o'qishni va yangi madaniyatlarni his qilishni xohlasa, exercise 2 ro'yxatidan qaysi IKKITA sabab unga eng mos keladi?
variantlar: Gaining Confidence va Make People Jealous
Invite Your Friends va Record Your Experience

savollar.savol: Mother Teresaning hayotidagi voqealar to'g'ri xronologik tartibda qaysi qatorda berilgan?
variantlar: Nobel mukofoti - rohiba bo'lish - tug'ilish - Missionaries of Charity
Rohiba bo'lish - tug'ilish - Nobel mukofoti - Missionaries of Charity
Tug'ilish - rohiba bo'lish - Missionaries of Charity - Nobel mukofoti
Missionaries of Charity - tug'ilish - Nobel mukofoti - rohiba bo'lish

savollar.savol: Mother Teresaning 'all people were equal' tamoyiliga asoslanib, u nima uchun ishlagan degan xulosa chiqarish mumkin?
variantlar: Barcha odamlarga, boylik yoki kambag'allikdan qat'i nazar, yordam berish uchun
Faqat boy odamlarga yordam berish uchun
Faqat o'z oilasiga yordam berish uchun

savollar.savol: Matndagi 'successful person' ta'riflaridan qaysi biri Mother Teresaning hayotiga MOS KELMAYDI?
variantlar: A person who succeeds by his/her own efforts
A person who thinks only about himself/herself
A person who works very hard

savollar.savol: Modal fe'llarning kuchini hisobga olib, xavfli vaziyatda eng kuchli ogohlantirish ma'nosi berilgan gapni toping:
variantlar: Is it a good idea to learn by heart all unfamiliar words?
It is a good idea to learn about other cultures.
One option is to persuade students to go to speaking clubs...
You are driving too fast. If you don't slow down, there could be a bad result.

savollar.savol: Mother Teresa vafotidan keyin Missionaries of Charity tashkiloti nima qildi, bu uning qaysi fazilati davom etganini ko'rsatadi?
variantlar: Tashkilot tarqab ketdi, chunki faqat u muhim edi
Tashkilot odamlarga yordam berishni davom ettirdi, bu uning g'oyasi mustahkam ekanini ko'rsatadi
Tashkilot haqida hech qanday ma'lumot yo'q

savollar.savol: Matndagi barcha ma'lumotlarni birlashtirib, muvaffaqiyatli shaxs bo'lish uchun eng muhim fazilatlar kombinatsiyasi qaysi?
variantlar: Tez boy bo'lish va dam olish
